title: The Milky Way
info: The Milky Way is the galaxy we live in. It holds billions of stars.
On a dark night it can look like a pale band across the sky.
The Sun is one star in the Milky Way. It is not at the galaxy's center.

options: the light of a huge number of stars
inside the Milky Way, not at its center
in the middle of the Moon
a huge collection of stars, gas, and dust
